name: Suzuran
source:
Suzuran came to Akihabara with Kikyou in order to carry out a certain mission.

Suzuran is a ninja who suffers from a typical Chuunibyou's delusions of grandeur. She claims that one of her eyes is a different color because it's her "evil eye," but she simply has a color contact put in. The truth behind the bandage she has wrapped around one arm, which she insists is "the black dragon from the demon world that I sealed away," is actually...

Even though Suzuran likes to make fun of the airheaded Kikyou, her jokes tend to miss the mark, and she often ends up being made fun of by the main character instead.

"Hmph... You shouldn't speak so brazenly. It makes you look weak."
